GET /healthz.description: Reports API process health and includes an X-Request-Id response header.

GET /readyz.description: Checks PostgreSQL connectivity and reports service readiness.

GET /api/articles.description: Returns published, non-deleted articles. Supports topic, author, search, date_from, date_to, sort_by, order, limit and p query parameters.

GET /api/articles/trending.description: Returns published articles ranked by votes, discussion and freshness.

GET /api/articles/feed.description: Returns the authenticated user's personalised feed from followed writers and topics.

GET /api/articles/drafts.description: Returns the authenticated user's private, non-deleted draft articles.

POST /api/articles.description: Creates a published article or private draft. Author is derived from the bearer token.

GET /api/articles/:article_id/manage.description: Returns an owned article, including drafts, for editing. Deleted articles are excluded.

GET /api/articles/:article_id/recommenda.description: Returns published recommendation candidates based on topic, author and engagement.

GET /api/articles/:article_id/revisions.description: Returns revision history for an article owned by the authenticated user.

GET /api/articles/:article_id/vote.description: Returns the authenticated user's stored Agree/Disagree state and whether they can vote.

GET /api/articles/:article_id/reactions.description: Returns aggregate Insightful, Useful and Funny reaction counts.

GET /api/articles/:article_id/reaction.description: Returns the authenticated user's active article reaction and whether they can react.

PATCH /api/articles/:article_id/reaction.description: Adds, switches or removes the authenticated user's Insightful, Useful or Funny reaction.

GET /api/articles/:article_id/comment-vo.description: Returns the authenticated user's vote state for comments on an article.

GET /api/articles/:article_id/comments.description: Returns the article discussion tree data. Deleted comments are returned as tombstones.

POST /api/articles/:article_id/comments.description: Posts a comment or reply on an active published article. Author is derived from the token.

POST /api/articles/:article_id/save.description: Saves/bookmarks an active published article idempotently.

DELETE /api/articles/:article_id/save.description: Removes the authenticated user's saved/bookmark state for an article.

PATCH /api/articles/:article_id.description: Either updates owner-controlled article content/status or changes Agree/Disagree vote state. Vote and content fields cannot be mixed.
PATCH /api/articles/:article_id.access: Authenticated; ownership required for content edits

DELETE /api/articles/:article_id.description: Soft-deletes an owned article and clears any profile pin pointing to it.

PATCH /api/comments/:comment_id/vote.description: Adds, switches or removes the authenticated user's Agree/Disagree vote on another user's active comment.

PATCH /api/comments/:comment_id.description: Edits the body of an active comment owned by the authenticated user.

DELETE /api/comments/:comment_id.description: Soft-deletes an owned comment, preserving a tombstone so existing reply threads remain intact.

GET /api/topics/trending.description: Returns topics ranked by recent article/comment engagement.

POST /api/topics.description: Creates a topic with a validated slug and description.

GET /api/topics/:slug/follow-status.description: Returns whether the authenticated user follows a topic.

GET /api/users.description: Returns the public user directory without password hashes or roles.

POST /api/users/register.description: Registers a user and returns the current profile plus bearer token.

POST /api/users/login.description: Authenticates a user and returns the current profile plus bearer token.

GET /api/users/me.description: Returns the authenticated user's current private-session profile state.

PATCH /api/users/me.description: Updates display name, avatar, bio and/or an owned published pinned article.

PATCH /api/users/me/password.description: Changes password after verifying the current password.

DELETE /api/users/me.description: Permanently deletes the authenticated account after password and exact username confirmation.

GET /api/users/me/activity.description: Returns dashboard statistics and recent non-deleted activity.

GET /api/users/me/saved.description: Returns the authenticated user's saved active published articles.

GET /api/users/me/following.description: Returns public profiles followed by the authenticated user.

GET /api/users/me/topics.description: Returns topics followed by the authenticated user.

GET /api/users/me/notifications.description: Returns up to 100 notifications plus unread_count. Use ?unread=true for unread items only.

GET /api/users/me/notifications/count.description: Returns the authenticated user's unread notification count.

PATCH /api/users/me/notifications/read-a.description: Marks all notifications for the authenticated user as read.

PATCH /api/users/me/notifications/:notif.description: Marks one owned notification as read.

GET /api/users/:username/stats.description: Returns public contribution/follow/received-vote statistics for a user.

GET /api/users/:username/comments.description: Returns a user's public non-deleted comments with article context.

GET /api/users/:username/follow-status.description: Returns follow state between the authenticated user and target profile.

POST /api/users/:username/follow.description: Follows another user idempotently and creates a notification on first follow.

GET /api/users/:username.description: Returns a public profile including bio and active featured article metadata.

POST /api/reports.description: Reports another user's active public article or comment for moderator review.

GET /api/moderation/reports.description: Returns reports filtered by open, resolved, dismissed or all status.

PATCH /api/moderation/reports/:report_id.description: Resolves or dismisses a report and writes a moderator audit event.

GET /api/moderation/analytics.description: Returns operational counts, active topics and contributor activity.

GET /api/moderation/audit.description: Returns recent moderation audit history. Audit rows remain after moderator account deletion.

GET /api/collections.description: Lists private collections owned by the authenticated user, with visible article counts.

GET /api/collections/:collection_id.description: Returns an owned collection and its active published articles.

PATCH /api/collections/:collection_id.description: Renames and/or updates the description of an owned collection.

POST /api/collections/:collection_id/art.description: Adds an active published article to an owned collection idempotently.

DELETE /api/collections/:collection_id/a.description: Removes an article from an owned collection.
